title: CBAP-1 verification context v0.1
description: Closed corpus representation of the verifier-local inputs supplied separately from a CBAP-1 bundle.

authorization_trust_profile_id.description: Lowercase hexadecimal representation of the expected Authorization Trust Profile identifier supplied by trusted local policy. The corpus format does not constrain its length; equality with the identifier carried in the CPO terms is evaluated by the verifier.

trust_set.description: Local role-authorized trust entries. The array intentionally has no minimum cardinality, uniqueness constraint, or corpus-defined ordering. Trust-resolution cardinality is evaluated by the verifier.

verification_time.description: Canonical decimal representation of the integer presented at the verifier boundary. The corpus format deliberately does not constrain the CBAP-1 unsigned range; range validation is performed by the verifier.

x.description: Lowercase hexadecimal representation of the COSE_Key x byte string. The corpus format does not constrain its length; CBAP-1 validity is evaluated by the verifier.

cose_key.description: Corpus representation of a local COSE_Key. Members are optional so that the test-vector format can represent structurally invalid local trust inputs. Their absence or invalid values are evaluated by the verifier where the CBAP-1 verification procedure requires those properties.

kid.description: Lowercase hexadecimal representation of the exact kid bytes associated with this local trust entry. The corpus format does not constrain length.

forum_id_authorization.description: Optional exact forum identifier authorized by this forum-role trust entry. Absence authorizes no forum identifier. URI conformance of the CPO terms forum-id and equality with this local authorization are evaluated by the verifier.
